chunks: Al-Khasa'is: My father, from Sa'd ibn Abdallah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: May Allah have mercy on the sisters among the inhabitants of Paradise and he named them: Asma bint Umays al-Khathamiyya who was married to Ja'far ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), and Salma bint Umays al-Khathamiyya who was married to Hamza. And five from Bani Hilal: Maymuna bint al-Harith who was married to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and Umm al-Fadhl with al-Abbas, her name was Hind. Al-Ghumaysa, mother of Khalid ibn al-Walid. Azza who was with Thaqif, with al-Hajjaj ibn Ghiladh. And Hamida, and she had no offspring.
ai.seo_question: Who are the five pairs of sisters from Paradise mentioned in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Khasa'il highlights the virtue of specific female companions, emphasizing that spiritual merit is not limited to the Prophet's immediate family but extends to those who supported the Ahl al-Bayt and the early Muslim community. The inclusion of figures like Asma and Salma bint Umays, who remained steadfast through multiple marriages and migrations, underscores the Shia emphasis on the enduring faith of the women of the household. The mention of their status in Paradise serves as a theological affirmation of their individual piety and their roles in preserving the legacy of the Imams.

en.ammaar-muslim: 3. [3/297] al-Khisal: My father from Sa’d b. Abdallah from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti from A’sim b. Humayd from Abi Basir from Abi Ja’far عليه السلام. He [Abi Basir] said:

I heard him [the Imam] saying: May Allah have mercy on the sisters among the inhabitants of paradise and he named them: Asma bt. Umays al-Khath’amiyya who was married to Ja’far b. Abi Talib عليه السلام and Salma bt. Umays al-Khath’amiyya who was married to Hamza.Also on five [women] from the Bani Hilal: Maymuna bt. al-Harith who was married to the Prophet صلى الله عليه واله. Umm al-Fadhl who was married to al-Abbas [b. Abd al-Muttalib] and her name was Hind. al-Ghumaysa the mother of Khalid b. al-Walid. Azza who was with the [tribe of] Thaqif and married to al-Hajjaj b. Ghiladh. Finally Hamida who had no children.
